etymologies.etymologyHTML: From Middle English ivi, from Old English īfiġ, from Proto-West Germanic *ibig, *ibag, *ibah, from Proto-Germanic *ibahs (compare West Flemish iefte, Low German Eiloov, Ieloof, German Efeu), from Proto-Indo-European *(h₁)ebʰ- (compare Welsh efwr (“black elder”), Ancient Greek ἴφυον (íphuon, “spike-lavender, Lavandula Spica”)).

definitions.definition: Any of several woody, climbing, or trailing evergreen plants of the genus Hedera.

quote.citation: 2023 March 8, “Network News: Pwllheli 'box gets a makeover”, in RAIL, number 978, page 22:
quote.text: Hidden timber elements, lintels and roof tiles have also been replaced, in addition to gaining a new paint job and guttering drainage, and the removal of ivy that was damaging the exterior.

definitions.definition: (by extension) Any similar plant of any genus.
